title: Here's Why You Shouldn't Run From The Police
description:
Here's Why You Shouldn't Run From The Police

In Onalaska, WI, an officer observed a speeding motorcyclist. As he attempted to conduct a traffic stop, the rider refused to pull over and fled. However, he was at such a high rate of speed within a residential area, that it didn't end well for him.
